summary: AGI Inc., a Brazilian financial services provider, filed a Form 6-K reporting its second-quarter 2026 results. The filing details routine operational and financial metrics: active customers grew 36% year-over-year to 7.6 million, total revenues reached R$3.2 billion (up 26%), net income was R$200.3 million, and the loan portfolio expanded to R$37.1 billion. The filing also announces an earnings conference call and includes forward-looking statements. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is present. This is an ordinary earnings release, not a special situation, so category 'None' is appropriate.
